title: The few add-back lines that name an organisation
question: When a line does name an organisation, what else does the record show about it?
finding: 17 items name 14 organisations the City pays, $2.7 million over both budget years; 11 of those organisations carry warning signs elsewhere in this file, led by Collective Impact (14 signs; $150,000 in June 2017).
how: An item counts as naming an organisation when its text contains the full name of a nonprofit in the City’s payment ledger, or one of nine unmistakable short names such as "Women’s Building".
limits: This is a name match on purpose text; it misses every organisation that is described rather than named, which is nearly all of them, and one line names an organisation only as the venue. A named line does not show the organisation received that sum. Campaign gifts are made by employees on their own account; employers are matched by name. The supervisor shown is typed from the Board’s public roster.
